artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan for the .ZTime ValidIn-iff characterization theorems and the coupled four-edit-site MainResults axiom pin.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, a build-time axiom pin on FormalSystem/MainResults.lean is a FOUR-edit-site change across three files, not three: the page itself, BOTH coupled heredocs in scripts/check-module-invariants.sh (C14_BASELINE and the generated C14LEAN Lean file, compared by exact string equality and required to list the same declarations in the same order -- the script says so in its own comment above them), and the per-file count in scripts/debug-artifact-allowlist.txt (C27), which must be read off the gate's own reported 'tree' value rather than computed by arithmetic. Editing C14_BASELINE alone fails C14 with a baseline divergence; omitting any site fails C21, which requires every name on the audit page be pinned by C2 or C14. Plan such a pin as one atomic-batch commit and revert all four sites together on failure. Separately: reverse-dependency footprint should be measured with grep -rln '^import <Module>$' up the aggregator chain before budgeting a rebuild -- MainResults.lean is a leaf (2 modules), not a full-tree trigger.
